description: 한국중부발전(주) 서울발전소 대기상태 현황 [electricity and power] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국중부발전(주). 본 데이터는 한국중부발전 서울발전소에서 수집된 대기 상태 측정 결과를 정리한 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 한국중부발전(주). Its tags are 대기상태, 환경, 서울발전소, 측정정보, 센서데이터. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
